system.longDesc:
Cost: 5 SP

Infiltration stunts may apply when physically breaking in somewhere or exploring a new place, hacking into a computer or network, pulling a con job, or otherwise evading consequences and getting away with things.

Choose a focus or talent your character doesn’t possess. An NPC of the GM’s choice with that focus or talent appears in the scene within a few minutes—or a few rounds later if your action leads directly to action time. This doesn’t dictate anything about their situation, attitude, or identity; these are all up to the GM
